name: rosetta-map-range
code:
use default

map_range(
    (a1, a2): (double, double),
    (b1, b2): (double, double),
    s: double
) -> double =>
    b1 + (s - a1) * (b2 - b1) / (a2 - a1)

(0::10)
    |> map(s =>
        (s, mapped = map_range((0.0D, 10.0D), (-1.0D, 0.0D), cast(s))))
    |> each((s, mapped) => write_line("{s} maps to {mapped:F1}"))
fullSource:
use default

map_range(
    (a1, a2): (double, double),
    (b1, b2): (double, double),
    s: double
) -> double =>
    b1 + (s - a1) * (b2 - b1) / (a2 - a1)

(0::10)
    |> map(s =>
        (s, mapped = map_range((0.0D, 10.0D), (-1.0D, 0.0D), cast(s))))
    |> each((s, mapped) => write_line("{s} maps to {mapped:F1}"))
